summary: Customer runs a continuous crystallisation and asks how to combine Raman and NIR probes at the same line point, fuse both data streams into one model for solute concentration and crystal form, and whether fusion is worth the effort.

facts_stated.text: The process is a continuous crystallisation.
They want to combine a Raman probe and an NIR probe at the same point in the line.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: combine a Raman probe and an NIR probe at the same point in the line

facts_stated.text: They want to fuse both data streams into one model.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: fusing both data streams into one model

facts_stated.text: The model targets solute concentration and crystal form.

customer_premises.claim: Raman and NIR probes can be combined at the same point in the line.
customer_premises.enquiry_quote: combine a Raman probe and an NIR probe at the same point in the line

customer_premises.claim: Fusing both data streams into one model is appropriate and beneficial.
customer_premises.enquiry_quote: fusing both data streams into one model

customer_premises.claim: The combined Raman/NIR setup can measure solute concentration and crystal form.
customer_premises.enquiry_quote: for solute concentration and crystal form

customer_premises.claim: A setup can be recommended before sample and process details are known.
customer_premises.enquiry_quote: How should we set this up

customer_premises.claim: Fusing the two techniques is worth the effort.
